tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page base under the ambient backdrop. Never a flat page on its own: always sits under a blurred still plus veil.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Wash laid over the blurred still so ink text reaches 4.5:1 on any artwork.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Default frosted panel fill. Always paired with blur-glass and glass-border.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Denser glass for controls and rows that sit on a glass panel (ballot options, secondary buttons).

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px specular edge on every glass surface and the 6px bezel of the stage.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and resting borders on glass-strong rows. Decorative only; never the sole state indicator.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, veil, glass and glass-strong. Also the fill of ink buttons and selected segments.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and helper lines on the same grounds as ink.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Violet fill: primary button, selected ballot border, choice A bar. Text on it uses on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Violet text and icons on ground, glass and glass-strong: labels, active nav item, choice letter A.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Violet tint for selected-row backgrounds and empty progress tracks. Text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Warm second voice: choice B fills, the logo dot, the active word in subtitles' speaker tag. Text on it uses on-saffron.

tokens.name: saffron-text
tokens.usage: Saffron-family text on ground, glass and glass-strong: choice letter B, countdown emphasis.

tokens.name: on-saffron
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a saffron fill.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Ballot-open dot and day-one status text on glass. A state colour: keep it small.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Closing-soon and expired status text on glass. A state colour: keep it small.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Fill behind episode artwork inside the player. Same in both themes: film is always dark.

tokens.name: on-stage
tokens.usage: Text and icons drawn over artwork inside the stage, always above scrim.

tokens.name: stage-glass
tokens.usage: Fill of small glass controls drawn over artwork inside the stage (play button, loading skeleton). Icons on it are on-stage; never put body text on it.

tokens.name: stage-glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge of glass controls and cards inside the stage, including the question card.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: End stop of the top and bottom gradients inside the stage that keep on-stage text legible.

tokens.name: subtitle-plate
tokens.usage: Plate behind subtitle lines. Subtitle text is on-stage on this plate.

tokens.name: subtitle-active
tokens.usage: The word currently being spoken in a subtitle line, on subtitle-plate.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One per screen, desktop hero only. Drops to display-title on phones.

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: Ballot question, result headline, screen titles on phones. For Devanagari set letter-spacing 0 and line-height 1.3 (the uw-title class does this when the element carries lang=hi).

styles.name: display-heading
styles.usage: Series and episode titles, panel headings.

styles.name: text-lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a display line.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: One ballot each. You can move it until the day ends.
styles.usage: Default body, option titles at weight 700.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow and status labels. Latin script only; never set Devanagari in uppercase tracking.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Spoken line inside the stage, on subtitle-plate. Latin words set in Plus Jakarta Sans and Devanagari in Anek Devanagari within the same line. Two lines maximum, 32 characters per line.

styles.name: subtitle-speaker
styles.usage: Speaker tag above a subtitle line, shown when the speaker changes or is off screen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside segmented controls and pill docks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inner padding of option rows; gap between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked rows inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; gap between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between text blocks in a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of compact glass panels.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Padding of hero glass panels on desktop.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between the stage and its side panels on desktop.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Desktop page margin.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Subtitle plate, progress segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Thumbnails inside option rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Ballot option rows, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Compact glass panels, trailer cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero glass panels, bottom sheets, series posters.

tokens.name: radius-stage
tokens.usage: The player stage on desktop. Use radius-2xl for the stage on phones.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, nav bar, docks.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Nav bar, docks, chips that float over the backdrop.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Glass panels.

tokens.name: shadow-stage
tokens.usage: The player stage only: the deepest element on any screen.

tokens.name: shadow-brand
tokens.usage: Primary button glow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The phone bottom sheet, which casts its shadow upward onto the stage.

tokens.name: blur-chip
tokens.usage: Small glass controls drawn over artwork inside the stage.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of every glass panel, with saturate(180%).

tokens.name: blur-ambient
tokens.usage: Blur of the full-bleed still that lights the page, with saturate(170%).

tokens.name: dur-tap
tokens.usage: Press and hover feedback.

tokens.name: dur-move
tokens.usage: Panels docking, sheets rising, selection moving between options.

tokens.name: dur-scene
tokens.usage: Ambient backdrop cross-fade when the episode or series changes.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for everything entering or settling.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Camera moves on stills and backdrop cross-fades.
